create_LitTestCase: create a LitTestCase instance wrapping a lit test and run object for unittest compatibility
test_LitTestCase_runTest: test the LitTestCase runTest method to execute a lit test and adapt results to unittest
review_LitTestCase_id: review the LitTestCase id method that returns the full name of the wrapped test
review_LitTestCase_shortDescription: review the LitTestCase shortDescription method returning the full test name
test_UnresolvedError: test the UnresolvedError exception raised when a lit test result is unresolved
